title: Weighted sum over subsets containing a coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and let $i$ be one of the $n$ coordinates. The sum of $\rho^{|S|-1}$ over all subsets $S$ of the coordinates that contain $i$ equals $(1+\rho)^{n-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
